scenes.description: Establishing extreme wide aerial shot of London skyline veiled in misty rain, slowly dollying toward a sleek modern glass financial skyscraper.
scenes.shot_intent: Establish geographic location, cold rational corporate mood, and rainy atmospheric tension.
scenes.information_role: Viewers immediately recognize an overseas financial epicenter setting.

scenes.description: Interior of London investment bank boardroom. Three sharp-suited executives at a long mahogany table. Mr. Harrison sits at the head with piercing gaze; Sandy stands with clicker by presentation screen.
scenes.shot_intent: Introduce key decision makers and establishing the formal hierarchy of the investment committee.
scenes.information_role: Presents Mr. Harrison as the supreme arbiter of capital approval.

scenes.description: Medium shot of Analyst Sandy pointing to the screen displaying Dacheng company's surging profit charts, delivering confident financial pitch.
scenes.shot_intent: Show conventional financial viability being presented before the non-financial obstacle is raised.
scenes.information_role: Shows that traditional balance sheets alone are no longer sufficient.

scenes.description: Medium close-up of Mr. Harrison steepled fingers, raising his chin thoughtfully, asking the pivotal ESG question with razor-sharp intensity.
scenes.shot_intent: Deliver the turning-point inquiry that derails the transaction.
scenes.information_role: Shifts evaluation from profit margins to non-financial sustainability metrics.

scenes.description: Close-up of Sandy's awkward expression, swallows slightly, clicks remote control with an uncomfortable fidget.
scenes.shot_intent: Highlight the vulnerability and hesitation when ESG data is absent.
scenes.information_role: Reveals the fatal flaw in the target company's disclosure.

scenes.description: Over-the-shoulder shot from Harrison to Sandy admitting zero emissions data and lack of labor verification.
scenes.shot_intent: Confrontation of the information void between analyst and decision maker.
scenes.information_role: Articulates the exact missing ESG components: emissions and labor.

scenes.description: Extreme close-up on Mr. Harrison's fingers rhythmically tapping the dark polished desk. Dead silence fills the room.
scenes.shot_intent: Build unbearable executive suspense before delivering the verdict.
scenes.information_role: Underscores that hesitation means rejection in high finance.

scenes.description: Medium shot of Mr. Harrison leaning back, delivering the cold 'black box' diagnosis with stern conviction.
scenes.shot_intent: Name the corporate risk: a black box that cannot be audited.
scenes.information_role: Establishes why investors equate non-disclosure with unquantifiable risk.

scenes.description: Quick medium shot of Sandy making a final feeble appeal regarding the attractive financial returns.
scenes.shot_intent: Show the last gasp of pure financial greed being crushed.
scenes.information_role: Illustrates the shift from return-focused to risk-gated decision making.

scenes.description: Close-up of Mr. Harrison decisively closing his document folder, commanding 'Put it on hold' with commanding finality.
scenes.shot_intent: Issue the death sentence for the capital round.
scenes.information_role: Provides the definitive cause for the corporate crisis.

scenes.description: Hero Motion Graphic Animation: Close-up on the cover of Dacheng Company's Capital Proposal. A heavy red rubber stamp slams down in dramatic slow-motion, stamping 'ON HOLD' in bold red distress ink with a reverberating sonic thud.
scenes.overlay_notes: Red 'ON HOLD' stamp imprint with spring overshoot impact physics.
scenes.shot_intent: Provide the iconic, visceral symbol of transaction freeze.
scenes.information_role: Visually seals the fate of the company's funding round.

scenes.description: Sound Bridge Transition: The heavy echo of the 'ON HOLD' stamp blends seamlessly into the loud, abrasive ringing of Amy's smartphone in Taipei.
scenes.shot_intent: Auditory causal bridge connecting the London decision to Taipei office consequences.
scenes.information_role: Directly links high finance actions to frontline employee reality.

scenes.description: Amy at her sunlit Taipei office desk organizing folders. Her smartphone suddenly buzzes violently across the desk with incoming call '協理 (主管)'.
scenes.shot_intent: Ground the protagonist Amy in her everyday normal workplace before disruption.
scenes.information_role: Establishes Amy as the relatable employee who will bear the burden.

scenes.description: Composite Split-Screen: Left panel shows Supervisor pacing and wiping sweat in his messy office; Right panel shows Amy picking up phone in alarm as supervisor shouts about the ESG black box.
scenes.overlay_notes: Vertical split-screen dividing line with slight animated pulse.
scenes.shot_intent: Deliver dual-character reactive comedy simultaneously during the phone call.
scenes.information_role: Communicates the supervisor's panic directly contrasting Amy's bewilderment.

scenes.description: Close-up of Supervisor wildly flailing arms, sweating profusely as he announces the threat to factory expansion and employee bonuses.
scenes.shot_intent: Escalate the stakes to directly affect the employee's wallet.
scenes.information_role: Translates esoteric ESG into relatable personal consequences: bonuses.

scenes.description: Close-up of Amy gripping her phone, jaw dropped, emerald green eyes wide in disbelief as she asks if the company isn't always compliant.
scenes.shot_intent: Voice the common workplace misconception: 'we follow laws, why is this an issue?'
scenes.information_role: Highlights the gap between basic legal compliance and proactive ESG.

scenes.description: Medium shot of Supervisor pointing an aggressive finger forward, hastily delegating the executive ESG briefing to Amy.
scenes.shot_intent: Classic corporate delegation of crisis to an unprepared subordinate.
scenes.information_role: Sets Amy's mission and driving objective for the entire course.

scenes.description: Medium shot of Amy shrinking slightly, sheepishly admitting into phone that she knows nothing about ESG.
scenes.shot_intent: Vocalize the learner's own vulnerability and intimidation with ESG.
scenes.information_role: Positions Amy as the learning surrogate for the audience.

scenes.description: Medium shot of Supervisor shouting 'Figure it out!' before slamming the phone down, leaving Amy staring dumbfounded at the screen.
scenes.shot_intent: Seal the dilemma: survival and bonuses are at stake, no retreat possible.
scenes.information_role: Forces the narrative forward into inquiry and research.

scenes.description: Medium close-up of Amy murmuring to herself: 'E...S...G... what kind of miracle medicine is this?' with comedic bewilderment.
scenes.shot_intent: Transition from real-world anxiety to surreal fantasy contemplation.
scenes.information_role: Sets up the humorous metaphor of ESG as an all-in-one magical pill.

scenes.description: Extreme close-up zooming directly into Amy's pupils. Her gaze slowly defocuses into a swirling dream bubble vignette.
scenes.shot_intent: Visual dream portal transition into Amy's internal comedic fantasy.
scenes.information_role: Signals the break into stylized parody.

scenes.description: Surreal TV Shopping Fantasy: Supervisor wearing sparkling golden disco blazer, passionately pitching 'ESG Concentrated Capsules' on a garish neon variety show stage with flying coins and skyrocketing stock chart graphics.
scenes.overlay_notes: Retro variety TV shopping graphics, flashing hotline phone numbers and 'BUY NOW' badges.
scenes.shot_intent: Satirize the commercial superficiality and magical thinking surrounding ESG.
scenes.information_role: Exposes the absurdity of treating ESG as a quick-fix pill rather than systematic management.
